items.title: Zora Co-Founder Dee Goens Replaces Jacob Horne as CEO
items.summary: Goens said Zora is now under 10 people after a headcount reduction this year and named ZORA buybacks among his first priorities.

items.title: AI Is Solving Math's Best Problems Faster Than They Can Be Replaced, Terence Tao Warns
items.summary: The Fields medalist points to a real race between OpenAI and Anthropic as proof: AI can now flatten a hard problem the moment someone starts working on it.

items.title: DoubleZero adds Kalshi election market data ahead of US midterms
items.summary: The expansion gives institutional and automated traders real-time access to Kalshi’s political markets as election betting activity continues to grow.

items.title: DoubleZero adds Kalshi’s election markets ahead of November midterms
items.summary: Kalshi's elections and politics markets went live on the market data delivery platform DoubleZero Edge on Wednesday.
